disciplines.name: Wrestling
disciplines.description: Wrestling is the art of control, balance, and determination. It teaches athletes how to dictate where the fight takes place through powerful takedowns, positional dominance, and relentless pressure. At its core, wrestling develops discipline, resilience, and the mindset to never give up an advantageous position.

disciplines.name: MUAI THAI
disciplines.philosophy: Known as the 'Art of Eight Limbs', Muay Thai combines punches, kicks, elbows, and knees into a powerful striking system. Its philosophy is rooted in respect, courage, and composure under pressure. Muay Thai teaches practitioners to remain calm, strike with precision, and develop both physical toughness and mental fortitude.

disciplines.name: BRAZILIAN JIU-JITSU
disciplines.philosophy: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu is the art of using technique and leverage over strength. It emphasizes problem-solving, patience, and adaptability, allowing a smaller person to overcome a larger opponent through superior positioning and submissions. The philosophy of BJJ is built on continuous learning, humility, and efficiency.

disciplines.name: KICK-BOXING
disciplines.philosophy: Kickboxing blends the speed and precision of boxing with the power and versatility of kicks. It promotes discipline, confidence, and self-control while developing effective stand-up fighting skills. The philosophy behind kickboxing is to create a balanced athlete who can move fluidly, strike decisively, and maintain focus under pressure.
